blocks.x: The 50 Best Bars 2026 (formerly The World's 50 Best Bars) have just been announced for 2026—this is the global bucket list for discerning drinkers to start ticking off.

For those unfamiliar with the list, The 50 Best Bars 2026 is one of the most prestigious bar awards on the planet: a definitive ranking of the world's most outstanding places to drink. The list is updated each year at an awards ceremony, which took place in Milan this year; the 2025 ceremony took place in Hong Kong.

The list is run by William Reed Business Media, the same company that produces The World's 50 Best Restaurants, widely regarded as the ultimate global restaurant ranking. The awards are compiled by The 50 Best Bars Academy, which comprises hundreds of anonymous industry experts.
Which bar was named the best bar in the world in 2026?
Hong Kong is home to the best bar in the world for 2026, as Bar Leone was crowned as the winner for the second year in a row in the ceremony in Milan on Wednesday, October. 7

2. Moebius Milano, Milan (Best Bar in Europe)
1. Bar Leone, Hong Kong (Best Bar in Asia & Best Bar in the World)
Which country and city has the best bars in the world?

Mexico City is the only city with two bars in the prestigious top 10—Bar Mauro and Handshake Speakeasy. However, Paris and New York remain two of the best destinations in the world for fans of incredible cocktails, with four entries on the list each.
How many of The 50 Best Bars 2026 are in the US?
In the main list of 50-1, there are four bars in the United States—all in New York City.
Which bars placed highest in each continent?

There are also awards given to the bars that place highest in each continent. This year, the best bar in the Middle East award went to Mimi Kakushi, Dubai, while Accra’s Front/Back was named the best bar in Africa. The best bar in Australasia was Caretaker’s Cottage, Melbourne. The best bar in Asia was Bar Leone, Hong Kong, while the best bar in South America went to Alquímico, Cartagena. The best bar in North America is Handshake Speakeasy, Mexico City and the best bar in Europe went to Moebius Milano, Milan.
Which bars won The World's 50 Best Bars 2026 special awards?

There were also some special awards outside of the list of 50-1. These include the Michter's Art of Hospitality Award, which, as the name suggests, recognizes a bar that provides outstanding hospitality. The 2026 award went to Alquímico. The Altos Bartenders’ Bartender Award, meanwhile, was awarded to Takuma Watanabe; Giorgio Bargiani, assistant director of mixology at The Connaught Bar in London, announced as the winner among Europe’s 50 Best Bars. The Campari One to Watch Award winner is Melbourne’s Three Horses, which ranked at number 84, while the Sevenrooms Best Bar Design Award was handed to Saikindō in Abu Dhabi. Panda & Sons, in Edinburgh, took home the Siete Misterios Best Cocktail Menu Award. Shingo Gokan was awarded the Roku Industry Icon Award.
